name: Kemonokko Hunter Juujin Hokaku Hanbainin no Kyonyuu Usa Mimi Musume Gohoushi Choukyou Nikki
original_name: 獣っ娘ハンター　獣人捕獲販売人の巨乳ウサ耳娘ご奉仕調教日記
source:
Our protagonist is a hunter who hunts down beast girls, trains them and then sells them to wealthy people for a living. This time, he has managed to entice a big breasted bunny girl named Mii into his trap. Ignorant to the ways of the world, Mii must be trained in order to be sold as a pet. Will you train her gently? Will you train her brutally? The final decision is all up to you, the player... !

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037808.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名猎人，靠捕捉兽娘、加以调教，再卖给富人为生。这一次，他成功诱骗名叫米伊的巨乳兔耳少女落入陷阱。米伊不谙世事，必须接受训练，才能作为宠物出售。你会温柔地调教她，还是残酷地调教她？最终决定权完全掌握在玩家手中……！

[内容取自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037808.html]DLsite English[/url]]
